Before creating the PR, please confirm the following checklists, otherwise, your PR will be closed.

- [ ] **Human-authored code only.** You may use AI as an assistant — for reviewing, refactoring suggestions, debugging help, or writing comments/docs — but every line you submit must be understood, reviewed, and owned by you. PRs that read like unreviewed AI output ("AI slop") will be closed on sight, and AI-generated code should remain a minor part of the change.
- [ ] **No AI bots as contributors.** PRs authored or committed by AI agents/bots (including `Co-authored-by` trailers attributing AI) are prohibited.
- [ ] **No code from unlicensed sources.** Code taken from other repositories must be published under an open-source license. Provide the source link and license in the PR description if you used any.
- [ ] **No duplicates.** Check that this PR is not a duplicate of an existing open PR. If it is, please comment there instead.
